The '''Ministration Hall''' was a structure in [[Derem City]] on the [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]]. When the planet's [[Ocean/Legends|sea]] levels rose, the [[City/Legends|city]], including the Ministration Hall, was flooded.<ref name="GatORW" />
